lenses.name: River flood exposure
lenses.description: Approximate share of hex area inside rare or millennial river-overflow flood surfaces from the official 2020 TRI synthesis. Values are raster-sampled estimates limited to designated TRI territories, not parcel-level risk determinations.

lenses.name: Coastal submersion exposure
lenses.description: Approximate share of hex area inside rare or millennial marine-submersion flood surfaces from the official 2020 TRI synthesis. Values are raster-sampled estimates limited to designated TRI territories; they do not include erosion, groundwater rise, drainage failure or parcel-level protection standards.
